text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Nature and the others and I went 
and bought some Hachimī on our day off!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"They had a free size-up promo going on, 
so I got to drink three times as much as 
usual! ♪"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Come with me next time, Trainer! Let's 
share a bunch of different flavors!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Twin Turbo had a very 
fulfilling day off!
